posts.author: Kaveh
posts.content_md:
The first comment is that keeping this forum posted is greatly appreciated. 

Site looks good. One thing that always makes me mad is pictures which can be mistaken for holographic images, but which are simulated, like on Liti and other sites. So as soon as you have a good color photo of a holographic image, it would be great if you can upload that.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
Hi Mike,

I was just looking at this page:

[http://www.fujifilmholography.com/html/ ... works.html](http://www.fujifilmholography.com/html/how_it_works.html)

It is an over simplification. If this set up was used it would cause a magnification that would render it useless. The reference beam in this case would either need to be colliminated (best) or the expanding lens would need to be a very long distance from the plate (ala Laser Reflections).

And Lippmann has two p's and two n's.

posts.author: MikeJ
posts.content_md:
Well we fixed the spelling, but I'm afraid you will just have to ignore the diagram. It was intended as it appears, an oversimplification, not a guideline.

Thank you for the input.
